name: Shuffleboard
description: Inhabits data management augments and rearranges stored information — contacts reorder, bookmarks shuffle, saved routes change sequence. Nothing is deleted. Everything is moved.
observed_behavior: Reorganizes personal data in patterns that seem random but occasionally reveal connections the user hadn't noticed.
story_hooks: A detective's contact list rearranges to put three seemingly unrelated names adjacent — and the connection breaks the case
